rows.maternity_billing: Delivery-only is separate; full maternity care bundles globally, with secondary newborn deliveries paid 50%.
rows.coding_requirements: Requires documentation of maternity care components and multiple-gestation coding for global or partial billing.

rows.maternity_billing: Additional vaginal deliveries pay 50%; cesarean extra payment requires review with Modifier 22.
rows.coding_requirements: Use Modifier 59 for vaginal, Modifier 22 for cesarean; cesarean documentation reviewed for extra payment.

rows.maternity_billing: Bundled in global OB package; itemized delivery codes allowed, with multiple-procedure reductions.
rows.coding_requirements: Requires appropriate OB global/delivery code selection; modifier 22 needs supporting documentation and itemized dated services.

reimbursement_policies.evidence: Vaginal delivery only is separately reimbursed when antepartum and postpartum care are not rendered; the policy does not add any DRG or MCC-specific rule.
Multiple-birth vaginal delivery claims are paid at 100% for the primary delivery and 50% for each secondary delivery when a multiple gestation diagnosis is present.

pairing_conditions: delivery of more than one newborn

reimbursement_policies.evidence: Commercial maternity delivery policy applies to multiple births and gives specific reimbursement rules for same-delivery or combined-delivery vaginal and cesarean services. The requested DRG is not named, but the policy addresses the same clinical area and imposes modifier requirements plus reduced payment for subsequent vaginal deliveries.

reimbursement_policies.policy_title: Obstetrical Policy, Professional - Reimbursement Policy - UnitedHealthcare Commercial and Individual Exchange
reimbursement_policies.evidence: No DRG-specific reimbursement rule is stated for this inpatient maternity DRG. The policy does address maternity professional billing: routine delivery is bundled into global obstetric packages, delivery-only and delivery-plus-postpartum CPT codes are defined, and multiple procedure reductions apply to OB codes with a delivery component. Separate payment is limited to specified itemized scenarios and modifier/documentation rules.

recommended_action.description:
Recommendation 1: Bundle 59510, 59514, 59515, 59620, and 59622 with related antepartum/postpartum codes 59425, 59426, and 59430 to one unit global OB code, limited to once per delivery and once per pregnancy when billed in the same global OB period, on the same date of delivery, and by the Same Group Physician/QHP or same TIN for full package; exempt different group practice and postpartum care only 59430. Apply to CA. Exempt: different group practice, postpartum care only 59430. Peer: United Health bundles 59510, 59514, 59515, 59620, and 59622 to one unit global OB code in the same global OB period, and Cigna limits maternity billing once per delivery and once per pregnancy..

Recommendation 2: For multiple-birth cesarean claims 59514, 59515, 59620, or 59622, allow separate additional payment only with Modifier 22 on the same claim as a multiple gestation diagnosis and documentation that all deliveries cesarean or there was delivery of more than one newborn; for combined-delivery method claims, require Modifier 59 per internal policy, and pay any subsequent vaginal delivery at 50%. Apply to CA. Exempt: provider, state, or federal contracts. Peer: Cigna and United Health both require Modifier 22 for obstetric delivery exceptions, and Cigna ties multiple-birth extra payment to same-claim multiple-gestation documentation..
